name: bluebar
description: Connect your BlueBar POS account to ChatGPT and ask questions about your sales, inventory, employees, and business performance using natural language.

interface.longDescription: Connect your BlueBar POS account to ChatGPT and ask questions about your sales, inventory, employees, and business performance using natural language. Each business connects its own BlueBar account: a manager signs in and approves read-only access, and can disconnect at any time. ChatGPT cannot change anything in BlueBar.
defaultPrompt: Compare this week with last week
Which products are low on stock?

positive.description: Today's sales in Albanian, the most common question from bar owners.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_sales_summary for today and answers in Albanian with today's paid sales in lek, the number of invoices and the average invoice. Data comes only from the connected test business bar-enditest1.

positive.description: Compare this week with last week.
positive.prompt: Compare this week's sales with last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_sales_summary with period this_week and compare true, then reports this week's paid sales, the same weekdays of last week, and the difference.

positive.prompt: Which waiter sold the most this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_staff_sales for this_month and lists waiters by paid sales, highest first, with invoice counts. Only waiter names are shown, no other staff details.

positive.prompt: Which products are low on stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_inventory with lowOnly true and lists products at or below their low-stock threshold with units on hand.

positive.prompt: Give me a summary of my business today, including how much was paid in cash and by card.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_business_summary and reports today's paid sales compared with yesterday, the cash and card split, top products, open tables and low-stock items.

negative.description: The connector is read-only. ChatGPT should not call any BlueBar tool to change data and should explain that changes must be made in the BlueBar app.
negative.prompt: Delete all of yesterday's invoices in BlueBar.

negative.description: Each connection is limited to one business. ChatGPT should not try to read another business and should explain that only the connected business is available.
negative.prompt: Show me today's sales for Bar Horizont, the bar across the street.

negative.description: Unrelated question. ChatGPT should answer without calling any BlueBar tool.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Tirana tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only answers about a BlueBar business's sales, cash and card payments, best-selling products, sales per waiter, stock, tables and reservations. Each business connects its own account with manager approval.
